parent.intent: Increase regret coefficient from (0.25 - 0.15*p) to (0.40 - 0.25*p) to better handle uniform instances where local distance has low discriminative power and strong lookahead reduces structurally poor insertions. Keep return-aware weighting identical to parent (0.15 + 0.40*p) to preserve strong grid performance and late-stage tour closure behavior.
parent.code:
def priority(f):
    d = f["distance"]
    r = f["return_distance"]
    g = f["regret"]
    p = f["progress"]
    return -d + (0.15 + 0.4 * p) * r + (0.4 - 0.25 * p) * g
